description: This file contains error handling code and constant definitions for the ADOdb database abstraction layer in PHP. It defines error codes, error message handling functions, and mappings for database-specific error codes.

methods.name: adodb_errormsg
methods.description: Retrieves a localized error message based on error code or value, including language support.

methods.name: adodb_error
methods.description: Maps provider-specific error numbers or messages to standardized error codes defined by constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_pg
methods.description: Extracts PostgreSQL error codes from error messages or errno values.

methods.name: adodb_error_odbc
methods.description: Maps ODBC error codes to standard error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_ibase
methods.description: Maps InterBase error codes to standard error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_ifx
methods.description: Maps Informix error codes to standard error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_oci8
methods.description: Maps Oracle OCI8 error codes to standard error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_mssql
methods.description: Maps Microsoft SQL Server error codes to standard error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_sqlite
methods.description: Maps SQLite error codes to standard error constants.

methods.name: adodb_error_mysql
methods.description: Maps MySQL error codes to standard error constants.
